title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Sofia Alvarez
release_notes: Added RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts. New examples for docs site and redwood-examples repo. No customer-facing breaking changes.
description:
Motivation: Provide opinionated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and end-to-end tool-calling quickstarts to help teams adopt agents and tool integrations with Redwood. This PR bundles example templates, runnable quickstarts (TS + Python), and updates to the docs site so the new guides are discoverable from the Getting Started and Agents sections.

What this includes: - 3 RAG agent templates (faq-bot, code-search-assistant, enterprise-docs-assistant) with config and sample prompts - Tool-calling examples for common patterns (search + clickthrough, database lookups, ticket creation) - Quickstart folders for redwood-examples: typescript and python ready-to-run samples with README and env config - Docs site updates: new agent quickstarts page, template reference, visual walkthroughs, and screenshots - Minor SDK example fixes and a README for migration notes

Checklist: - [x] Add templates to redwood-examples/agents/templates - [x] Add TS + Python quickstarts under redwood-examples/quickstarts/rag-agents - [x] Update redwood-docs site navigation and pages - [x] Add CI examples step in quickstart README - [x] Run e2e smoke tests locally and in CI

Testing and validation: I ran the example quickstarts locally against the hosted API and a local private deployment image. CI run (docs build + examples smoke tests) passed after fixing a missing env var in the TS example. The examples include small automated checks that the agent can invoke a mock tool and return an expected text snippet.

Rollout notes: This is a docs/examples-only change; no runtime or API changes. Merge is safe to main. We'll run a short internal announcement and link the new quickstarts in the weekly newsletter.

Related: ENG-4123 (template and quickstart work), PM-897 (docs and discoverability), SUP-221 (support request for example templates).

merge_commit_title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
notes: This PR is documentation and examples only. No runtime API or SDK breaking changes. The quickstarts include mock tools and CI smoke tests to keep examples runnable in CI. We'll follow up with a short blog post and internal announcement.
example_run_instructions: See redwood-examples/quickstarts/rag-agents/README.md - set REDWOOD_API_KEY, MOCK_TOOL_URL, then run npm install && npm run start for TS, or python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && python example.py for Python.
migration_notes: None required. Templates are opt-in and do not change runtime defaults.
security_implications: Mock tools are used in examples; real integrations should follow standard auth patterns. No secrets checked in. Documented KMS recommendations in templates.md.
